## Change

What problem does this solve? For visual changes, include before/after screenshots.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Leave unchecked anything not verified.

- [ ] Java build and relevant algorithm checks passed, if app code changed.
- [ ] Relevant desktop interactions checked, if Swing or graph behavior changed.
- [ ] `npm --prefix website run verify` passed, if the website changed.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile layouts checked, if website presentation changed.

## Limitations

Mention known issues, compatibility changes, or checks that still need to run.
